caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug placed at an angle on a plain background. The main field of the rug is yellow with a subtle pattern of smaller floral shapes in lighter yellow. Five large, white motifs with irregular, cloud-like forms and purple outlines are spaced evenly across the central area, with hints of brown and yellow within the white motifs. The rug’s border consists of a wide band that is primarily purple, adorned with a repeating circular gray motif and yellow stylized floral designs. Inside the purple border, there is a narrower, yellow band with smaller floral patterns and highlights of white. The rug is shown with shadowing lines along its left and lower edges, suggesting some depth. There are fine crosshatched and directional lines throughout, replicating the texture of woven fabric. The words "M.Hali Lofçeli 41" are inscribed in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Silk Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
